# Pat Lib Online — Full Machine-Readable Documentation
> LLM-first UI pattern library with deterministic retrieval contracts and lossless raw artifact transport.
> Version: 2026.02 | Schema: 2.0.0

## Base URL

https://ai-lib-library.netlify.app

## Quick Start for LLMs

1. Fetch the compact index: GET https://ai-lib-library.netlify.app/api/llm/index?format=compact
2. Search by task: GET https://ai-lib-library.netlify.app/api/llm/search?q=hero+section&mode=code&format=compact
3. Retrieve a pattern: GET https://ai-lib-library.netlify.app/api/llm/patterns/1.4?packOnly=true
4. Get raw TSX: GET https://ai-lib-library.netlify.app/api/llm/raw/patterns/1.4.tsx

## API Endpoints

### Index & Discovery
| Method | URL | Description |
|--------|-----|-------------|
| GET | /api/llm/index | Full index with metadata, taxonomy, navigation |
| GET | /api/llm/index?format=compact | Minimal-token index |
| GET | /api/llm/health | Health check |
| GET | /api/llm/contracts | API response schema contracts |
| GET | /llm-index.json | JSON feed of the full index |
| GET | /llms.txt | This summary document |

### Pattern Retrieval
| Method | URL | Description |
|--------|-----|-------------|
| GET | /api/llm/patterns | All patterns (supports filters: q, mode, industry, category, tag, limit) |
| GET | /api/llm/patterns/{id} | Single pattern detail |
| GET | /api/llm/raw/patterns/{id}.tsx | Raw TSX source (text/plain, no HTML) |

### Playbook Retrieval
| Method | URL | Description |
|--------|-----|-------------|
| GET | /api/llm/playbooks | All playbooks |
| GET | /api/llm/playbooks/{slug} | Single playbook detail |

### Reference Retrieval
| Method | URL | Description |
|--------|-----|-------------|
| GET | /api/llm/references | All reference documents |
| GET | /api/llm/references/{id} | Single reference document |
| GET | /api/llm/references/{id}/sections | Sections index for a reference |
| GET | /api/llm/references/{id}/sections/{sectionId} | Single section |
| GET | /api/llm/raw/references/{id}.md | Raw markdown source |

### Search
| Method | URL | Description |
|--------|-----|-------------|
| GET | /api/llm/search?q={query} | Unified search across patterns, playbooks, references |
| | &scope=all\|patterns\|playbooks\|references | Filter by content type |
| | &mode=prompt\|code | Filter by retrieval mode |
| | &format=full\|compact | Control response verbosity |

### Prompt Composition
| Method | URL | Description |
|--------|-----|-------------|
| POST | /api/llm/compose/lovable | Compose a builder-ready prompt from playbook + patterns |

POST body: `{ "playbookSlug": "dentist-landing", "selectedPatternIds": ["1.4", "10.1"], "variables": {} }`

## Query Controls (Token Efficiency)

All collection and detail endpoints support:
- `format=full|compact` — control response verbosity
- `packOnly=true` — alias for `format=compact`
- `fields=id,name,objective` — project only specific fields (comma-separated)

## Stable Identifiers

- Human pattern ID: `1.4`
- Canonical pattern ID: `patlib.pattern.1.4`
- Canonical route: `/api/llm/patterns/1.4`

## Response Format

All JSON API responses follow consistent contracts. Fetch `/api/llm/contracts` for the full schema definition.

## CORS

All `/api/llm/*` endpoints allow cross-origin requests (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *).
